svg.aria-label: ExtraTunnel. For security teams. Proof you can check, not a promise. Every request takes the same path. It is sealed and checked on the laptop, the model sees only stand-ins, the real values come back on the way home, and a signed receipt is written for each one. Below, one request end to end, with made-up values: an agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor asks for a fix about Dana Whitfield; the seal turns the name into a stand-in, Rohan Malhotra; the check finds 0 real values left; the AI provider sees only the stand-in; the restore puts the real name back; and a signed receipt joins the chain.
